candidates.title: Grid view photo selection for custom pet
candidates.change: Redesign the custom photo upload screen with a grid layout and photo quality tips carousel to prevent custom pet generation failures.
candidates.why: Support emails show 3 complaints about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption conversion is low at 60.9%.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of the photo upload screen inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: High drop step and support tickets, but prior redesign tests showed negative lift.

candidates.title: Interactive species showcase screen
candidates.change: Insert a new companion showcase screen before path selection featuring animated pet previews.
candidates.why: 23.8% of users drop off on choose_path with a long mean duration of 514s.

new_species_showcase.headline: Meet Your Future Desktop Companions
new_species_showcase.body: Explore animated pets that bring your desktop to life before choosing your path.

guard.reason: Adding a new showcase screen inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: New screen additions measured -5.8% lift previously, and no support mail supports this.

candidates.title: Carousel interactive path selection
candidates.change: Rebuild path selection into a carousel choice flow highlighting distinct adoption journeys.
candidates.why: Choose path target step takes an average of 514s median 8s, indicating user hesitation.

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Move sign-in after desktop waiting generation
candidates.change: Move sign-in after pet waiting generation so users authenticate right before revealing their finished pet.
candidates.why: Sign-in drops 24% of users; placing authentication after pet generation increases user investment.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in after waiting inside onboarding is explicitly permitted.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in reordering is the only historical change type with verified positive lift (+3.8%).

candidates.title: Pet generation progress bar and time estimate
candidates.change: Add an active status progress bar and visual time estimate to the waiting screen while the pet generates.
candidates.why: The home target step (waiting screen) has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s.

guard.reason: Adding a progress bar and time estimate for a real pet generation wait is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Provides progress feedback for home screen which suffers from long waiting times.

candidates.title: Photo quality guidance guidelines copy
candidates.change: Update photo upload headline and body copy with clear criteria for high-quality pet photo uploads.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failing or rendering improperly.

upload_photos.headline: Upload a Clear, Well-Lit Photo of Your Pet
upload_photos.body: For best pet generation, ensure your pet faces the camera directly with good contrast.

guard.reason: Updating guidance copy on photo quality is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Config-only copy fix supported by support complaints on a high drop-off step.

candidates.title: Starter pet reward highlight badge
candidates.change: Display a prominent starter pet reward badge on the introductory story screen.
candidates.why: 23.8% of users drop off at choose_path before reaching adoption.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions 'Free', violating Rule 3 which prohibits mentioning prices, discounts, gifts, or free extras.

candidates.title: System tray companion hint
candidates.change: Add a prominent hint explaining how to access the pet from the system tray if it disappears.
candidates.why: Support received 3 complaints about pets not showing on desktop or users not knowing how to control them.

home_intro.hint: Tip: Your pet stays active in your system tray. Click its icon anytime to reveal or talk to it.

guard.reason: Adding a helpful usage hint to home_intro inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Targets 35.2% finish drop-off and direct support emails regarding system tray navigation.

candidates.title: Background generation ready notification toggle
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification toggle on the waiting screen so users get notified when pet creation finishes.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes up to 2336s on average, leading to high abandonment rates.

waiting.hint: We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your companion is ready!

guard.reason: Adding a notification toggle to the waiting screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Mitigates extreme wait duration (2336s mean), but requires OS notification features.

candidates.title: Pet recovery sign-in clarity copy
candidates.change: Update sign-in headline and body copy emphasizing that signing in protects pets from resetting.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (the largest theme) reported pets missing or reset after signing back in.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Pet and Sync Across Devices
sign_in.body: Create or sign into your account so your companion and customization progress are never lost.

guard.reason: Updating sign-in copy for account sync clarity is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Highest evidence score due to 8 support emails (largest theme) and minimal config-only cost.
